source.release_date_note: The dataset landing page read 'Release date: 22 October 2026' on the access date; that is the page's latest release (the 2026 provisional edition), not necessarily this edition's. The zip's members are dated 13 October 2026.

reference_period: Workbook Notes: annual estimates are for the tax year that ended on 5 April in the reference year, so the 2025 edition is tax year 2024-25. The directory is named for the build's rule period, 2024 (tax year 2024-25), not for the ASHE edition.
coverage: Workbook footnote a: employees on adult rates who have been in the same job for more than a year. All employee jobs, full-time and part-time; a person with two jobs counts twice.

unpublished.rule: A section whose mean is 'x' or ':' keeps blank numbers and the marker; it is never written as 0.

all_row: sic_section 'ALL' is the sheet's 'ALL EMPLOYEES' row, the fallback for sections without a published mean.
